mutation: production's only portfolio call site is repointed at the retired v20 distance-proxy implementation
guard: portfolio_health.assert_not_reachable, read from the LIVE call-site source

mutation: the ENSEMBLE is removed: a single tree replaces the hundred the published default grows, so E[h(x)] is one draw rather than an expectation
guard: PH.1 reports the published ensemble size, and E[h(x)] is an expectation over it

mutation: c(n) drops the -2(n-1)/n term of the published closed form
guard: the reported normaliser is c(psi) = 2H(psi-1) - 2(psi-1)/psi, recomputed here from the published closed form and not read back from the module

mutation: the external-node adjustment c(size) is dropped, so a node holding several points is treated as if it had isolated one
guard: at least one project's mean path length exceeds the tree height limit, which is only possible when the external-node adjustment is being added

mutation: every project is scored by its OWN forest fitted on the other projects -- the v20 behaviour section 6 forbids -- so the scores displayed together are on different scales
guard: every score reported together IS the score ONE forest fitted on the whole cohort produces, recomputed independently in the probe from the reported model metadata

mutation: the ensemble stops being seeded: the declared seed is recorded on the model but the trees are drawn from an unseeded generator, so the same cohort returns different scores
guard: two independent computations of the same cohort return IDENTICAL scores

mutation: the governed cohort is reduced to a single project
guard: a cohort with fewer than two eligible members abstains under an explicit INSUFFICIENT_COHORT disposition and emits no anomaly score or flag for any project

mutation: the anomaly score is contaminated by the RAW FEATURE MAGNITUDE, so the reading depends on the units the features happen to be recorded in
guard: the most anomalous project is UNCHANGED under the declared affine rescaling x -> 1000x + 7

mutation: PH.2 declares itself a learned machine-learning model, which it is not: nothing is trained and no parameter is estimated from data
guard: PH.2 declares is_learned_model false and is_probability_of_failure false, and its method note says nothing is trained or fitted

mutation: the midrank is replaced by a POSITIONAL rank, so a tied project's percentile depends on where in the cohort its record happened to arrive
guard: the two tied projects receive the SAME midrank, and every project's midrank is identical whichever order the records arrive in

mutation: a required governed feature is removed from one project
guard: PH.2 ABSTAINS on a missing required feature: the feature is not silently dropped and the remaining features are not renormalised over a smaller set

mutation: the OLS fit is replaced by the endpoint change divided by the NUMBER OF OBSERVATIONS -- three observations contain two intervals, and this divides the same rise by three
guard: the slope on t=[0,1,2], x=[1.0,0.9,0.8] is exactly -1/10, computed here from the supplied oracle and not read back from the module

mutation: the actual reporting dates are replaced by list position
guard: the fitted slope is the slope over the ACTUAL reporting interval: 2026-01-01, 01-08 and 03-01 are 0, 7 and 59 days apart, and the slope per day differs from the slope over positions 0, 1, 2

mutation: one observation is given a different stable signal identity
guard: two different signals are never fitted as one trajectory: the history is refused rather than blended

mutation: the project itself is left in its own peer set, so every project's nearest neighbour is itself at distance 0 and similarity 1
guard: no project appears in its own neighbour set or its own distance table

mutation: the unvalidated 0.15 match radius from v20 is reinstated as an operational threshold
guard: PH.4 applies NO match threshold and reports the continuous relationship instead

mutation: matching a peer is turned into an adverse status: a status colour is emitted from the existence of a nearest neighbour
guard: PH.4 emits no status colour and declares that similarity is not failure

mutation: the declared tie rule is dropped: instead of all tied neighbours in ascending project-id order, the FIRST tied neighbour in arrival order is returned
guard: every pairwise distance and every nearest-neighbour set is identical whichever order the records arrive in

mutation: a constant 0.5 placeholder is reinstated as the composite score and the confidence -- the v20 defect that pulled every project's composite toward the middle
guard: every project profile carries score None and confidence None, and the only number on a profile is its evidence-body count

mutation: PH.1's own ensemble size is made to depend on whether a PH.3 history exists, so a missing constituent silently changes the value of a constituent that is present
guard: a missing PH.3 constituent leaves PH.1, PH.2 and PH.4 BYTE-IDENTICAL, names D1.3 as a missing constituent, and renormalises nothing because there are no weights to renormalise

mutation: the evidence-body count is replaced by a count of CONSTITUENTS, so the same result offered twice under two module ids reads as two supporting observations
guard: duplicate lineage does not raise confidence: the distinct-evidence-body count is unchanged, confidence stays null and corroboration stays false

mutation: a scalar composite and a weight set are emitted although no governed normalisation, transformation, weight set, missingness policy or calibration objective exists
guard: PH.5 emits no scalar and no weights, and its disposition is PARAMETER_PROVENANCE_BLOCKED

mutation: the portfolio readings are merged into `module_results`, the field Project Status, the category rollups, fusion and the vote all read
guard: the portfolio snapshot is stored ONLY on its own column, `module_results` comes from the project run alone, and no D1 identity is in the two-module voting set

mutation: the mixed-reporting-period check is disabled, so records from two different periods enter one comparison as though the portfolio had been observed at one moment
guard: a cohort whose members do not share ONE period and ONE feature schema is refused: both halves of the comparability boundary are exercised in the same probe

mutation: the Category-9 eligibility gate is removed, so UNASSESSED evidence enters the cohort and is analysed as though it had been assessed
guard: an UNASSESSED record is excluded from the cohort, is named in the excluded set with its reason, and never becomes an analysed member
